segments.source: The HD8749/01 reviewed here has a manual pannarello, despite the word 'milk' in its historical URL. Its automatic espresso and lungo controls, front access and removable brewer suit someone seeking straightforward beans-to-cup coffee with occasional hands-on frothing. Three strength levels and a five-position ceramic grinder provide a modest adjustment range without a recipe screen. The incorrect route label must not become a promise of one-touch cappuccino: the owner still moves the cup and prepares the milk. Confirm the black 230 V base Naviglio identity when buying, and choose a genuine automatic-milk version if that convenience is essential.
